title: University of Utah Research Park Act
short_title: University of Utah Research Park Act
committees: H-Natural Resources Committee: Referred To 2025-04-10 -> Discharged 2025-06-25 -> Markup By 2025-06-25 -> Reported By 2025-09-15 [Federal Lands Subcommittee: Referred 2025-04-23 -> Hearings By (subcommittee) 2025-04-29]
committee_votes: Natural Resources Committee 2025-06-25: Ordered reported - Unanimous consent
summary: University of Utah Research Park Act This bill confirms the use by the University of Utah of approximately 593 acres of specified nonfederal land in Salt Lake City, Utah, as a university research park and for related university purposes (including development of student housing and a transit hub) as a valid public purpose.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
